lotteryDescription:
Riseboro Community Partnership and Nehemiah HDFC are pleased to announce applications are now being accepted for two (2) newly constructed HOMES. South Bushwick Neighborhood HOMES 1143 Hancock Street Brooklyn, NY 11221 and 676 Central Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11207 in the South Bushwick Neighborhood of Brooklyn. 

This development is being offered through two separate Housing Connect lotteries. Although they appear as separate listings, they are part of the same residential development. Please note this lottery is ONLY for the South Bushwick two or three family HOMES.

• Eligible buyers must have 5% of the purchase price available 
• The homes were built with the intention of being placed on Interboro Community Land Trust (CLT).
• Each home buyer must occupy the home as their primary residence.
• Applicants household members may have NEVER owned

Homeowner’s will be responsible for their unit’s Electrical Bill, Internet, Cable, Water, Upkeep/Maintenance.
